_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Man Hours Expenditure Chart
summary: This chart is an index of contractor effort used by the Government to compare actual man hours expended versus man hour estimates over a given period of time.
use_relationship:
This chart is an index of contractor effort. It is used by the Government to compare the actual man hours expended versus the man hour estimates over a given period of time.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirements for this data included in the contract.
This DID may be applied in any contract and during any program phase to acquire the man hours expenditure chart.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format and Content:
preparation_instructions.content: The chart shall be on 8 1/2 x 11 graph paper with a 20 x 20 per inch matrix or metric A4 with a 2.5 cm matrix to be furnished by the contractor. A convenient scale will be chosen to depict the man hours expended on the vertical axis and the projected time of the contract on the horizontal axis. A broken line will be plotted to depict the number of man hours estimated to accomplish the effort. The estimated number of man hours depicted on this chart should agree with the estimated number of man hours depicted on other technical data items called out under this contract for the same work effort. A solid line will be plotted to depict the actual man hours expended on the contract during the prescribed period.

children.title: Revised estimate lines
children.content: will be constructed on the chart by the contractor when contract modification causes the original estimate to be no longer suitable for the intended purpose.

children.title: Substantial variance for original estimates
children.content: Whenever substantial variance for original estimates can be anticipated, the contracting officer or his duly authorized representative shall be advised promptly.

preparation_instructions.title: The chart shall be a reproducible master
preparation_instructions.content: and shall remain in the possession of the contractor during the life of the contract.
